title: Why China Wants to Master the Robotic Hand
summary: China is making a big bet on humanoid robots, with dexterous hands as its focus. It’s a key to building a stronger manufacturing base while addressing a slowly shrinking workforce. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Billionaire Mittal Says OneWeb Leads Musk in India Satcom Race
summary: Indian tycoon Sunil Bharti Mittal said his Eutelsat OneWeb venture is “significantly ahead” of Starlink in India’s satellite-communication approval queue, amid Elon Musk’s criticism that some oligarchs are blocking his attempts to gain spectrum access in the country.

title: ASML Shares Rise as Chip-Gear Maker Can’t Keep Up With AI Demand
summary: ASML Holding NV shares rose after the Dutch company said soaring artificial intelligence spending means it’s searching for ways to produce more chip-making machines over the next two years.

title: IMF, World Bank Tout Bangkok Blueprint Against Digital Fraud
summary: The International Monetary Fund and World Bank unveiled a global roadmap to fight online financial fraud as increasingly sophisticated scams undermine confidence in digital finance.

title: Ark's Wood Favors Nvidia, AMD in 'Volatile' Chip Cycle
summary: Cathie Wood, founder, CEO and CIO of Ark Investment Management, discusses why she avoids traditional memory-chip players, saying the business cycle is "most volatile." Speaking on Bloomberg Television, Wood adds that we are "just at the beginning" of the artificial intelligence revolution. "In terms of our semiconductor exposure, [we] tend to be at the less-cyclical end of the spectrum," she adds. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Sunil Mittal Warns AI Is Outpacing Regulation
summary: Sunil Mittal says governments are struggling to keep pace with the rapid pace of AI innovation, and suggests that regulation should provide guardrails without stifling innovation. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: ASML Raises Full-Year Sales Outlook
summary: ASML upgraded the low end of its 2026 sales forecast as increasing artificial intelligence spending boosts demand for the Dutch company’s chip-making machines. The firm projected annual sales of between €44 billion ($49 billion) and €45 billion this year. ASML's outlook offers an indication of investment plans by chipmakers like TSMC, Samsung Electronics and Intel. Bloomberg's Tom Mackenzie reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: India’s Goyal Calls US Ties ‘Very Good’ Despite Trade Tensions
summary: India’s ties with the US are “very good,” Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal said, even as trade tensions simmer and after President Donald Trump irritated New Delhi by claiming he helped mediate an end to armed clashes with Pakistan.

title: Cheaper Yuan Debt Gives Chinese Firms an AI Funding Edge
summary: Tencent Holdings Ltd. is leaning into cheap offshore yuan debt to bankroll its artificial-intelligence infrastructure, the latest prominent example of leading Chinese tech firms using that edge over global rivals.

title: Singapore’s PDG Seeks $1.2 Billion Loan for Malaysia Data Center
summary: Asian data center operator Princeton Digital Group Ltd. is seeking a syndicated loan of up to $1.2 billion to fund its Malaysia buildout, according to a person familiar with the matter, as the debt binge to finance artificial intelligence infrastructure continues.

title: Hitachi Energy CEO on AI, Energy Security and Grids
summary: Hitachi Energy CEO Andreas Schierenbeck discusses whether the electricity infrastructure industry can expand fast enough to support the AI boom and industrial electrification, and how his company plans to convert demand into sustainable growth. He also explains why electricity networks are increasingly becoming a national security issue, not just an infrastructure challenge. He speaks with Shery Ahn from the sidelines of "Bloomberg New Economy Forum". (Source: Bloomberg)

title: India’s Jaishankar on Key Foreign Policy Objectives
summary: Dr. S. Jaishankar, Union Minister of External Affairs, Republic of India speaks with Bloomberg's John Micklethwait at the 2026 Bloomberg New Economy Forum in New Delhi. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: China's Robotic Hands Key to $5 Trillion AI Humanoid Development Race
summary: Advanced humanoid hardware is one of the strategic high-tech fields where China has an early lead over the US.

title: Malaysia Taps China’s Satellite Tech for Earlier Flood Warnings
summary: Malaysia is turning to Chinese satellite technology for earlier warnings of floods that hit the country during its annual northeast monsoon, Bernama reported.

title: China’s Producer Prices Jolted by Oil as Inflation Rebounds
summary: China’s producer inflation swung higher last month, as escalating hostilities in the Middle East sent oil prices surging past $100 a barrel and goods related to AI became more expensive.

title: A $90 Million Spyware Hack Sparks Review of Crypto Wallet Sales
summary: Crypto hardware maker Ledger SAS is reviewing its policies and processes for how its devices are sold to consumers, after spyware implanted in some wallets led to an estimated $90 million in stolen cryptocurrency.

title: OpenAI Says Staffer Arrested for Hidden Recording Device in Office
summary: An employee at OpenAI was arrested and charged with using a hidden recording device in one of the company’s San Francisco offices, according to statements from the artificial intelligence company and the US Justice Department.

title: Anthropic Asks Appeals Court to Rehear Fight Over Security Risk
summary: Anthropic PBC urged the federal appeals court in Washington to revisit its decision upholding the Trump administration’s designation of the artificial intelligence company as a supply-chain risk to US national security.

title: Microsoft AI Focused Data Center Plan to Add 26 Gigawatts of Compute
summary: Shortages forced the company to turn away some AI and cloud business. Now it’s planning for 38 gigawatts of data center capacity to meet demand.

title: Vista Equity CEO Smith on Growth of AI, Agentic Software
summary: Robert F. Smith, Vista Equity Partners founder, chairman and CEO, talks about the growth of artificial intelligence, agentic software and the importance of learning how to use an AI agent. He speaks to Dani Burger at CAIS in Beverly Hills, California.  (Source: Bloomberg)
